remarks: Welcome to this spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom end-unit townhouse in the Evergreens townhouse community, less than a minute to Transit Rd! The townhouse offers spacious room sizes, abundant natural light, and a fantastic layout designed for comfortable everyday living. As an end unit, this home offers an abundance of windows and natural light throughout, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere. The generously sized rooms provide plenty of space for both relaxing and entertaining, while the well-designed floor plan offers the flexibility today’s buyers are looking for. The large kitchen features a nice eating area with built-in cabinets, skylights and a sliding door to the deck and private wooded lot. The living room/dining combo gives you options to design the space as you like or need! The living room features a fireplace and built-ins. On the second floor, you will find three nice size bedrooms and two full baths, including the ensuite with high ceilings, double closets and a full bath.The second full bathroom services the two additional bedrooms. The half bathroom is off the foyer and 1st floor laundry are conveniently located. The home also features a two-car attached garage and a full basement, providing exceptional storage and additional space for a home gym, recreation area, workshop, and other possibilities.  New AC '26, With its combination of spacious interiors, beautiful natural light, ample storage, and convenient two-car garage, this townhouse is a wonderful place to call home. Come see all that this inviting property has to offer including ease of lifestyle!  Snow removal, lawns, water and trash are all taken care of through the HOA!
